purpose: Illustrative category imagery, not supplier-specific product photography
card_prompt_template: Use case: product-mockup. Create one isolated technical product visualization of {subject}. Premium realistic industrial catalogue render for Airtechnic Solutions. Brushed silver stainless steel, restrained dark steel-blue RAL 5009 painted components, believable joints and fasteners. Three-quarter view, entire equipment centered with generous transparent margin, soft neutral studio light from upper left. True transparent background including holes, no floor, no scenery, no grid, no cast background shadow, no text, no logo, no watermark. Match a coherent engineering equipment catalogue. Illustrative product configuration, clean and precise, not futuristic.
